entries.en: Oh God, I--I'm so sorry! The guys talked me into it!
entries.ro: Doamne, î--îmi pare rău! Băieții m-au convins!

entries.en: And? Ain't got a mind of your own, 'ey? Be happy you still got all your fingers.
entries.ro: Și? N-ai minte proprie, a? Fii fericit că mai ai toate degetele.

entries.en: They--they said if got a "handful of Valentina ass," I--I--I could roll with them!
entries.ro: Ei--ei au zis că dacă iau o „mână de fund de Valentina”, pot să umblu cu ei!

entries.en: <mothertongue l="mex" m="Jesús" b="" a=", you sound like a dying animal. Here, in Vista, they put down dogs like you."/>
entries.ro: <mothertongue l="mex" m="Jesús" b="" a=", suni ca un animal pe moarte. Aici, în Vista, împușcăm câini ca tine."/>

entries.en: <mothertongue l="mex" m="mierdecita" b="Listen " a=", I'll let you off this time. But you ever mess with a Valentino again, might not walk away."/>
entries.ro: <mothertongue l="mex" m="mierdecita" b="Listen " a=", I'll let you off this time. But you ever mess with a Valentino again, might not walk away."/>
